summary: Stream cipher primed from an object-held rolling key pointer: XORs len bytes of the destination buffer a2 with a rolling key stream. The key stream lives at a1 + 309 (dword index 325 of the object) and is refilled on demand by sub_564F10 in blocks of 16 dwords. Refill triggers when the pointer is null or the consumed offset since refill reaches 0x3F (63) bytes.

operations.description: Loop over the destination buffer for i in [0, a3), consuming one key byte and XORing one byte per iteration, and advancing a1[325] on every iteration.
Before XORing, check whether the key pointer a1[325] is exhausted: refill when it is null or when its consumed offset (v6 - a1 - 1236) is at least 0x3F.
Reset the key pointer a1[325] to a1 + 309 (dword index 309) when a refill is needed.
Call sub_564F10(a1, a1 + 309, 16) to regenerate a 16-dword block of keystream into the a1 + 309 buffer.
XOR one output byte with the current keystream byte: *(_BYTE *)(i + a2) ^= *(_BYTE *)a1[325].
